facts.claim: The entire Dublin Castle campus is closed to the public until January 2027 for Ireland’s Presidency of the Council of the European Union.
facts.sourceLocation: Sorry, We Are Closed: the Dublin Castle campus is closed to the public until January 2027; primary State venue for events during Ireland’s Presidency.

notes: Official source captured with proxy and normal TLS; relevant passages read. Dated prior-season content is not evidence for 2026 dates. Route, budgeting and pacing suggestions are original editorial advice.
